page.overview:
Who is Darth Wrend?

Darth Wrend was a legendary Sith Lord who fought against the Jedi Order and was believed dead, only to return and fight them once again. Around 67 BBY, Jedi Padawan Qui-Gon Jinn wondered whether a prophecy in the holocron of prophecy about evil returning once "the righteous [lost] the light" referred to Darth Wrend rather than a potential reincarnation of the Sith Order as believed by others who had known the prophecy.

Darth Wrend was a Sith Lord who was one of the earliest holders of the title Darth. They fought against the Jedi Order and was eventually thought dead. At some point afterward, the Sith nevertheless returned to wage war against the Jedi. By the time Jedi Padawan Qui-Gon Jinn began studying the holocron of prophecy Darth Wrend was considered legendary among the Order. Around that year, Jinn read an ancient prophecy stating that the Sith would disappear yet return again once "the righteous [lost] the light." The Padawan mentally considered that most notes on the prophecy had interpreted it as a potential reincarnation of the Sith Order, though Jinn wondered that it might specifically refer to Wrend and their return from believed death to fight the Order once again.

In 40 BBY, when Obi-Wan Kenobi was the Padawan of Jinn, Kenobi mentioned the prophecy to his Jedi Master and complained about its vagueness.

Darth Wrend was first mentioned in a flashback in the 2019 novel Master & Apprentice, written by Claudia Gray. but exist within the game's files.
